principles: No secrets in Git or workflow JSON
No direct agent access to production database or RouterOS
No demo fallback presented as real telemetry
Privileged actions require backend authorization and durable audit
payment_rules: A receipt image is not proof of settlement
Verify provider signature or query trusted provider
Check unique reference, amount, currency and recipient
network_rules: Trusted source IP and TLS/private tunnel
Isolated RouterOS test device before production
No agent-triggered production reboot or disconnect
n8n_rules: Do not expose editor/webhooks publicly without TLS and authentication
